data.gender_notes: Pradum is used as a masculine name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Pradum is derived from the Sanskrit word 'pradhan' which means chief or leader. This name signifies prosperity, wealth, and strength. It is believed that a person with this name will be successful in all his endeavors and will be a leader in his community. The name Pradum carries the meaning “Prosperous, Wealthy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Pradum usually hope their child will grow to embody prosperous, wealthy and live with faith, good character and purpose.

historical_references.reference: Pradum was an influential Jain monk who lived during the 12th century CE in India. He was a prominent figure in the Digambara sect and is known for his works on Jain philosophy and scripture.

Pradumshah I, also known as Pradun or Pradhan, was a ruler of the Chalukya dynasty in the Deccan region of India. His reign lasted from 1182 to 1202 CE. During his time, he expanded his territory to include parts of the Western Chalukya Empire and was a notable patron of art and culture.
